reasoning_content:
The tests that were previously failing are now passing when run individually. In other words, the 4 failures during the full-suite run were timeouts (property-based tests that hit the 15-second timeout under the high load of 8 parallel workers). This is an environmental load issue, not a bug in the installed software.

Let's verify that the application actually builds and runs. That's the core of the "installation" verification. First I'll run the build, then check whether `npm start` (the development server) works.
